lines.text: Did you know? Vent is Latin for come.
Venue: a place people come to.
Quick quiz! Which means together plus come?

words.ex: Our trip to the jungle was a real adventure.
The city hosts a large book convention every year.
The venue for this year's conference has not yet been announced.
